author: Wahiz
body:
So this is basically where I think Avicus Game modes should be headed in the state they're in.

Avicus's main game mode is DTM/CTW the reason for that is because they're the most popular and a lot of competitive tournaments, matches, and scrims can come out of  them, and that's why people like them so much. But game modes like Nexus and Control The Hill have died over the past months and has gotten to the point were no one will or likes to play them anymore.

So by now you think the staff/developers/map developers would've removed those game modes and started projects to make different game modes that catch new comers interested. Like everyone has seen Kit pvp, and Survival Games. Why not come up with some genuine Avicus game modes and give them a good old Avicus twist to them.

Regarding bringing new game modes, I think KOTH was a great game mode to bring to Avicus, because lots of good can come out of it seeing it's a very popular game mode on other servers. I know this has already done, but with the Atlas update coming and the change from YML to XML will help spice that game mode up and give it an Avicus style to it.

The game modes that haven't died on the Avicus Network is Nebula and Walls. The reason for that is they both have their own little communities inside of them where players who enjoy that game mode interact etc... and then on the other hand Nexus and CTH get 0-5 players on a week half of the time.

Here is a list of game modes that should be added/or added back; (Old and New)

-Skywars, people seemed to really enjoy that and I've seen a few forum posts/reply's regarding skywars. It seems like it would bring new players who enjoy that  game mode and won't have to step into the competitive Nebula Game mode

-KOTH, already talked about it

-Avicade a lot of people really enjoyed those games, and I did myself. They were fun little quick games that everyone played a fair bit of.

No I'm not saying give each one of these game modes a server, but mix them with other ones. or add them to the mix rotation minus the Avicore this may help out with the game modes a bit.

So what do you think of my suggestions/Ideas?

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body: I think considering our server size, it's better to just label gamemodes by themselves (e.g give snake it's own server and ghost squadron it's own server) because Avicade as a whole label seems unnecessary. It seems to work for a lot of other servers, and when we had it here, a lot of people just wanted to play one gamemode rather than wait through 6 others to get to what they wanted to play. It's more convinent and easier that way, in my opinion.
